question: Which river originates at Mahabaleswar in Maharashtra, passes through Sangli and meets the sea in the Bay of Bengal at Hamasaladeevi in Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Krishna**:

 
 
• It **originates **at **Mahabaleswar in Maharashtra**, passes through Sangli and **meets **the sea in the** Bay of Bengal at Hamasaladeevi in Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• After the Ganges and the Godavari, the Krishna River is the third-longest and fourth-largest river in I
